texts.preamble: Ram Bachhan Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand on 7 February, 2024 Author: Ambuj Nath Bench: Ambuj Nath In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi W.P (C) No. 6150 of 2014 Ram Bachhan Singh --- --- Petitioner Versus 1. The State of Jharkhand 2. Adjudicating Officer-cum-Deputy Commissioner, Ranchi 3. Prescribed Officer-cum-Designated Officer-cum-Additional Chief Medical Officer-I, Ranchi 4. Sri Sanjay Kumar, Food Safety Officer, Civil Surgeon's Office, Ranchi --- --- Respondents --- Coram: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath --- For the Petitioner: Mr. A.K. Sahani & Mr. Ajit Kumar, Advocates For the Resp.-State: Mr. Arun Kr. Dubey, A.C to G.P-Iii --- 10 / 07.02.2024
texts.facts: Petitioner has filed this writ application for quashing of order dated 28.06.2014, passed by the Respondent No. 2-Adjudicating Officer-cum-Deputy Commissioner, Ranchi in Food Safety & Standards Case No. 57/2013-14, whereby and wherein, a penalty of Rs. 3.00 lakh has been imposed upon the petitioner. 2. Aforesaid case was tried in the Court of Adjudicating Officer-cum- Deputy Commissioner, Ranchi, alleging therein that the complainant-Food Safety Officer had purchased 800 gms. of peda for the purpose of analysis on payment of Rs. 240/- from the sweetmeat shop of the petitioner. Thereafter, Memorandum in Form VI was prepared and part of the sealed sample along with Form VI was sent to the Food Analyst for analysis. Report of the Food Analysis revealed that Peda was adulterated as starch was present as extraneous matter. 3. Petitioner has come before this Court against this order.
texts.arguments: 4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Respondent drew the attention of the court towards the fact that Tribunal has already been created to act as an Appellate Forum and the power has been vested in the Court of Additional Judicial Commissioner within the Judgeship of Ranchi. 5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that in view of the order dated 28.11.2016 passed in this writ application, petitioner had deposited 50% of the penalty amount before the competent authority on 01.03.2017. 6.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Respondent drew the attention of the court towards the fact that Tribunal has already been created to act as an Appellate Forum and the power has been vested in the Court of Additional Judicial Commissioner within the Judgeship of Ranchi. 5.
